hints.title: Group Connected Indices
hints.text: Any positions connected through a chain of allowable swap pairs can be arbitrarily permuted among themselves.

hints.title: Collect Characters per Component
hints.text: Group indices belonging to the same component and extract their corresponding characters from the original string.

hints.title: Sort and Distribute Lexicographically
hints.text: Sort both the list of indices and their characters ascending, placing sorted characters into the sorted index locations.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.time: O((V + E) * alpha(V) + V log V)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating individual swap operations leads to infinite cycles or exponential permutations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Connected component identification with disjoint set union groups indices in near-linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that transitivity of swaps allows sorting characters within each connected component independently.
complexity.notes: Sorting characters within each component yields the lexicographically smallest result.
